args: Run the /self-improve weekly routine: retro every finished or week-old root that has none, then look across projects for corrections the maintainer keeps making (2+ independent occurrences for standing taste, 3+ for process or skill changes) and drop a proposed root task with the evidence for each. Never edit memory, rules or skills unattended.
description: Every Monday at 9:00 AM, runs /self-improve across active projects to propose fixes for the corrections the maintainer keeps making, for their approval.
